params.body:
Items 2, 4 and 5 of the view-logic audit of 2026-09-13 (the audit itself is saved as docs/bedrijfsregels/93-logica-in-views.md; 91 was taken by the open points).

**Agreement and borderel print from the saved model (item 2).** Both templates printed `request()->takeover_price`, and the borderel also `request()->actual_millage`, the description, the checklist and the keys: whatever the browser posted, and blank on any render outside that request. The controller now saves what the form posts (new columns `borderel_mileage`, `borderel_keys`, `borderel_checks` json, `borderel_description` on export_vehicles; `takeover_price` was already saved) and passes `ExportVehicle::agreementDocument()` / `::borderelDocument()` to the views, which read only that array. A test asserts no print template reads `request(` and that the borderel document is built from the model.

**Bidding windows on the model, enforced (item 4).** `ExportVehicle::DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS = 7`, `WINNER_WINDOW_DAYS = 15`, `CONTROL_WINDOW_DAYS = 14` with `daysRemaining()`, `winnerDaysLeft()`, `winnerMayBeSet()`, `controlDaysLeft()`; the arithmetic is the templates' own (unchanged numbers on screen). export/index, biddingDetails, form and the bidding browser use them. `VotingController::setWinner` refuses with 422 and "De termijn om een winnaar te kiezen is voorbij (15 dagen na de einddatum)." when the window is closed; the page shows that message and unticks the switch. Unit tests with Carbon::setTestNow. Not touched: the `BiddingBox.php:65` open-check that differs from `isBiddingOpen()` (audit note).

**Mails decide for the recipient (item 5).** `sold_email` and `bought_email` showed the purchase price on `auth()->user()->can_see_purchase_price`: the clicker's right, while the sold mail goes to the seller. The flag lives per user and the mails go to the dealer's general address, so `App\Support\MailRecipient::canSeePurchasePrice(Dealer)` decides: the user whose e-mail is the dealer address when there is one, otherwise only if every user of that dealer has the flag (a shared mailbox is read by anyone there), and never for a dealer without users. Passed into SoldEmail and SoldBuyerEmail. `open_worklist_items` read `Auth::user()->role_id` from a command with nobody logged in, so the transport line was never mailed; the command now passes the recipient user and the Mailable decides.

Docs: B1-1.10, B1-3.6, B1-5.7, B1-6.2 point at the new methods; `@rule` tags on the tests.

Local tests could not run in the worktree (shared vendor autoloads the main checkout); CI decides.
params.title: Bidding windows on the model, documents from the model, mails for the recipient
